title: Health and Disease
summary: What keeps us healthy, how diseases spread, how the immune system and vaccines protect us, why herd immunity matters, and how epidemiologists track down outbreaks.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Health depends on relationships between our bodies, pathogens, our lifestyles and our communities, and fair access to clean water, vaccines and healthcare benefits everyone.

factual: What is the difference between communicable and non-communicable diseases?
conceptual: Why does vaccinating many people protect those who can't be vaccinated?
How do scientists use evidence to find the source of an outbreak?
debatable: Should vaccination be compulsory for school entry?
Is it fair that some countries get vaccines much earlier than others?
